summary: A blind ogre drinks an extra-healing ray after the hero directs a stethoscope at it. zap.c:bhitm heals the ogre and calls muse.c:mcureblindness before its visible improvement message. JS skips that void call with note_unported, so the cure message and sight-state transition are missing.

source.branch: For SPE_EXTRA_HEALING (or skilled SPE_HEALING) on a non-Pestilence monster, bhitm saves the HP delta, prevents wakeup anger, heals the monster, then calls mcureblindness(mtmp, canseemon(mtmp)) before mimic/visible-improvement output. The selected ogre is blind and visible, so mcureblindness clears mcansee/mblinded and emits its cure line before 'looks much better.'
callers: zap.c:weffects sends a monster-target ray through zap.c:bhit with bhitm as callback; js/zap.js:weffects -> bhit -> bhitm is the production route exercised by the recording.
dependencies: muse.c:mcureblindness is already implemented in js/muse.js and returns void; bhitm discards its result. This correction replaces only the existing skipped call and does not claim new completion credit for the helper.
